description: Create and activate a 64 MiB swap file at /swap-gym with permissions 0600. It must activate automatically at boot.
Configure a 64 MiB memory-backed filesystem at /mnt/gym-ram. Mount it now and ensure it is mounted at every boot.
On disk {disk}, create a GPT partition of approximately 768 MiB. Format it with XFS and mount it at /mnt/gym-data. The mount must persist across reboots.
hint: Review lsblk, parted, mkfs.xfs, blkid and fstab.
checks: p=$(findmnt -rn -M /mnt/gym-data -o SOURCE); test "$(lsblk -ndo PKNAME "$p")" = "$(basename {disk})"; test "$(lsblk -ndo TYPE "$p")" = part; s=$(blockdev --getsize64 "$p"); test "$s" -ge 790000000 && test "$s" -le 820000000

description: Use disk {disk} to create a physical volume, volume group gymvg and logical volume data of 512 MiB. Format it with XFS and mount at /srv/gym-data persistently.
hint: Review pvcreate, vgcreate, lvcreate, mkfs and fstab.
checks: test "$(lvs --noheadings --units m --nosuffix -o lv_size gymvg/data | xargs | cut -d. -f1)" = 512
pvs --noheadings -o pv_name,vg_name | awk '$2=="gymvg" {print $1}' | while read -r p; do test "$p" = {disk} || test "$(lsblk -ndo PKNAME "$p")" = "$(basename {disk})" || exit 1; done

description: Create an approximately 512 MiB partition on {disk}, format it as ext4 and mount it persistently at /mnt/gym-ext4.
checks: p=$(findmnt -rn -M /mnt/gym-ext4 -o SOURCE); test "$(lsblk -ndo PKNAME "$p")" = "$(basename {disk})"; s=$(blockdev --getsize64 "$p"); test "$s" -ge 520000000 && test "$s" -le 550000000
